snippet.title: Letter Lost - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624790/Letter_Lost/

Take a first peek at Letter Lost by FlatNine Games!  Live out your wildest dreams of being a postal worker, stamping and sorting mail for residents of the mysterious island of Kharnym. Perform your duties, keep the mail running on time, and this could be the last job you’ll ever have.

Lyrics for full "Kharnym Lullaby" by Benjamin Emory Larson (https://benemorylarson.com/)
Trailer by Anthony Anderson (https://despisedsamaritan.com/)
